summary: Renewal-reminders feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS covering GET /api/reminders (window/days_left/urgency/count/ordering), snooze/keep/cancel actions, monthly+weekly+yearly cycle advance, PUT reminder_days_before persistence, and auto-seed defaults (reminder_days_before=3, snoozed_until=null). Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844, fresh signup → dashboard renders 'Heads up — charges coming' with YouTube Premium (in 2d) + Spotify (in 3d) rows, tab-badge-dashboard shows '2', Snooze YouTube removes row and decrements badge to '1', Cancel Spotify removes row and drops active count, add-form exposes all four form-remind-{1,3,7,14} chips and saves. CRITICAL BUG: Add/Edit form UI has the Remind-me-before-charge picker but the save() handler in /app/frontend/app/subscription/[id].tsx omits reminder_days_before from the request body, so the user's chip selection is silently discarded and the backend stores the default 3. On reload the picker reverts to '3d before' (verified by computing bg color of form-remind-7 after re-open: rgb(255,255,255) i.e. inactive) and by an isolated API repro. Notification-prompt behavior on web: state='unsupported' path hides the card entirely — problem statement allows this ('either not appear or be dismissible without crashing'), so no crash — but the requested testID dashboard-notif-prompt/dashboard-enable-notifs is only render-gated on 'unknown'/'denied', never on 'unsupported', so on web it never renders (dismiss-without-crash path not exercised on web preview). Deprecated warnings unchanged from iteration 1 (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, reanimated transform-origin) — cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: reminder_days_before is NOT included in the POST/PUT body. UI picker (form-remind-{1,3,7,14}) updates local state but the field is never sent, so backend stores default 3 and on next open the picker reverts to 3d. Fix: add `reminder_days_before: reminderDays` to the body object at lines ~45–49. Also include `snoozed_until: existing?.snoozed_until ?? null` to keep snooze intact through edits.

integration_issues.issue: Reminder-window picker selection lost on save because request body drops reminder_days_before (see UI bug above).

issues: Notification permission card testID='dashboard-notif-prompt' never renders on web because notifState becomes 'unsupported' (not 'unknown'/'denied'). Either widen the render condition to include 'unsupported' with a dismissible variant, or accept the silent-hide (problem statement explicitly permits 'not appear on web'). Currently no way to exercise dashboard-enable-notifs testID on the web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeat warning from iteration 1 — 'shadow*' style props deprecated on React Native Web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/reminders.tsx (styles.wrap uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) and existing /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx (styles.heroCard).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning persists. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx line ~279 (`<View style={hStyles.donutCenter} pointerEvents="none">`).
Console error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' persists — cosmetic.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/app/subscription/[id].tsx save() body (line ~45), add `reminder_days_before: reminderDays` (and ideally `snoozed_until: existing?.snoozed_until ?? null`) so the picker selection actually persists.

MEDIUM: Decide whether the notif prompt should render on web (state='unsupported'). Either add 'unsupported' to the render condition with a friendlier copy + a dismiss button, or document that it is intentionally hidden on web (spec allows).
LOW/cosmetic: Migrate shadow* → boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/reminders.tsx (styles.wrap) and other files; move pointerEvents="none" onto style block on donutCenter.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py grew to ~447 lines with the new /reminders, /snooze, /keep, /cancel endpoints — still under 700-line threshold, but reminders logic (window computation, urgency bucketing, advance_renewal) is a natural extraction candidate.
advance_renewal correctly clamps to shortest month (e.g. Jan 31 monthly → Feb 28/29) and handles Feb-29 yearly leap-year edge with a try/except.
GET /api/reminders correctly filters by status='active' and honors snoozed_until (only future snooze dates skip); items are sorted by days_left ascending — verified.
Frontend RemindersSection uses react-native-reanimated FadeInDown/FadeOut/LinearTransition for enter/exit — works but generates transform-origin DOM warning on web.
auth-context.refreshReminders is invoked after login/signup and after every keep/cancel/snooze (via act()) — good state hygiene.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 acceptance criteria met — reminder-days picker persistence broken)

UI-test user also has TEST_UI_Rem7 (created via form) and TEST_Weekly/TEST_Yearly/TEST_CancelMe (backend tests). Snooze/cancel state applied to YouTube Premium/Spotify on the UI-test user. Demo user demo@suborganizer.app is untouched this iteration — but note its seeded next_renewal dates from iteration 1 have drifted (renewals are stored as absolute dates at signup time), so a fresh testing agent expecting YT in 2d / Spotify in 3d on the demo user will find stale data; use a fresh signup for reminder-window UI tests instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_reminders_api.py (new) and /app/backend/tests/test_suborganizer_api.py (iteration 1). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests -v`. Reminder-related testIDs: reminder-<Name>, reminder-keep-<Name>, reminder-cancel-<Name>, reminder-snooze-<Name>, tab-badge-dashboard, dashboard-notif-prompt, dashboard-enable-notifs, form-remind-{1,3,7,14}. IMPORTANT: sign up a NEW user for reminder UI tests — demo user's YouTube/Spotify offsets have decayed since iteration 1 (dates are absolute at seed time). After fix for the reminder_days_before persistence bug, re-verify by (a) selecting form-remind-7, save, reopen the sub, and asserting form-remind-7 has active background (theme.color.ink, roughly rgb(26,28,30)), and (b) confirming a sub with `offset_days`=5 (iCloud+) surfaces in /api/reminders after saving with reminder_days_before=7 via the UI (backend already passes this test in isolation).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of reminder-days picker not persisting: /app/frontend/app/subscription/[id].tsx maintains `reminderDays` state via useState but its save() handler builds the request body without including that field. Since backend SubscriptionIn.reminder_days_before is Optional with default=3, PUT/POST silently reset it to 3. Reproduction: (1) log in as any user, (2) tap Add sub, (3) select form-remind-7, (4) fill name+amount, save, (5) reopen sub — picker shows 3d selected (or all inactive). Verified via isolated API call: PUT payload with reminder_days_before=14 stores 14, PUT payload without stores 3. Mitigation: add `reminder_days_before: reminderDays` to the body at line ~45 in save() (one-line fix).
